tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Dell PowerEdge R750 Server is a powerful 2U rack server designed for demanding enterprise workloads, virtualization, cloud computing, database applications, and data center environments. Powered by 3rd Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors, the R750 delivers high performance, scalability, and reliable computing capabilities for modern business applications.


The Dell PowerEdge R750 supports two Intel Xeon Scalable processors and offers extensive memory capacity with DDR4 ECC Registered DIMMs. Its flexible storage configuration supports a wide range of SAS, SATA, and NVMe drives, making it suitable for applications that require high storage performance and capacity.


With advanced Dell server management features, PCIe expansion capabilities, redundant power supply options, and enterprise-grade reliability, the PowerEdge R750 is a strong choice for virtualization, database management, high-performance computing, enterprise applications, and data center deployments.


Key Features


  • Dell PowerEdge R750 2U Rack Server
  • Dual-socket server platform
  • Supports 3rd Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors
  • High-performance DDR4 ECC memory support
  • Flexible SAS, SATA, and NVMe storage options
  • Multiple PCIe expansion slots
  • Supports high-speed networking and storage controllers
  • Enterprise-class redundant power supply options
  • Advanced Dell server management capabilities
  • Designed for virtualization and cloud workloads
  • Suitable for databases and enterprise applications
  • Ideal for data center and business-critical workloads
